workflow: A bulk output operation caches the size and pointer of mutable backing storage before processing chunks.
Each chunk invokes user-controlled callback code that may clear, shrink, or replace the same storage.
The callback returns, but the operation continues using the cached size and pointer without revalidating them.
A later chunk reads released, null, or undersized storage, causing a use-after-free or out-of-bounds access instead of safe handling.
summary: Reentrant callback invalidates cached backing storage
decision_reason: The failure workflow materially matches reentrant invalidation of a backing resource before later use: user-controlled callback execution changes or releases the resource, and the outer operation continues with stale state without revalidation.
